products.name: Waveshare ESP32-S31-Zero-N16R16
products.summary: ESP32-S31 Zero；16 MiB Flash/16 MiB PSRAM，GPIO60 WS2812 与 BOOT61 数字输入子集。
limitations: 按精确 N16/N32 Flash 与 R16/R32 PSRAM 分四个运行配置，-M 仅区分排针包装；不同 SKU 的设备存储身份独立。
真实 CPU→IO_MUX/RMT→GPIO60 WS2812 GRB 已验证，并有 GPIO59 错接负对照；BOOT61 按下/释放由 guest GPIO 读取证实。RMT 位解码仅为数字高低占比子集，不声称模拟/时序物理验收。
板载没有显示屏、触摸或 TF 插槽；11_boardtest 的外部工装不自动挂入设备。USB、Wi-Fi/Bluetooth、完整原厂启动与实机未验证。
官方固件头/分区为16MiB，在32MiB包装上只使用相同低16MiB布局；不改写原始镜像。固件checksum/SHA与芯片S31已核对。
厂商公开 PcbLib 和尺寸/照片；3D外观及排针模型验收仍待补充。
UIFlow1、UIFlow2、小智：官方型号 README/资源页本轮未列精确目标镜像，上游专项目标核验未知，不将S3/C6同名Zero镜像作为替代。
3D 来源：dimension-photo-reconstruction；生产Three加载器/原生尺寸/屏幕射线/展开复位已检验；部分结构和光学尺寸有明确限制，未宣称浏览器WebGL或实物装配通过。
Model: No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Model: Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.
Model: No manufacturer3D model exists in the inspected official footprint streams. Photo-faced partial PCB represents18×28mm board without inferring hidden components or traces.
Model: Only front visible appearance is photo-backed. Rear geometry, component heights, antenna stack and FPC mating cavity remain unmodeled; UNKNOWN label is visible on rear.
Model: Header-M geometry has correct nine-per-side count and2.54mm pitch but estimated lengths; bare and-M assets are separately selected.
Model: BOOT is a genuine GPIO61 hit target. RESET is visually identified but uses the platform reset action; RGB is actual guest RMT output on GPIO60.
NOR JEDEC EF4018/EF4019 是按16/32MiB选择的虚拟Winbond兼容输入场景，不是实物Flash厂牌鉴定；继承的SFDP只含部分头，未捏造密度/BFPT表。高于16MiB的SPI命令地址模式仍受现有MSPI协议子集限制，MMU数组边界独立验证。
官方FactoryOnly包含外接LCD/触摸/SD测试夹具流程；公开Worker在5.14客体秒内反复Store access fault并软件复位。Zero板本体没有该屏幕/TF槽，未模拟测试夹具；这次运行不代表原厂应用通过。

chronology.notes: Official storefront position is a scheduling proxy; firmware dates are not hardware release dates.
